DROP TABLE Member;

SET LINESIZE 200;
SET PAGESIZE 200;
SET DEFINE OFF;

COLUMN memberID        FORMAT A6 HEADING 'MemID';
COLUMN memberName      FORMAT A15 HEADING 'MemberName';
COLUMN contactNum      FORMAT A12 HEADING 'ContactNum';
COLUMN memberEmail     FORMAT A17 HEADING 'Email';
COLUMN dob             FORMAT A9 HEADING 'DOB';
COLUMN registerDate    FORMAT A9 HEADING 'Registered';
COLUMN expiryDate      FORMAT A9 HEADING 'Expires';
COLUMN memberStatus    FORMAT A7  HEADING 'Status';
COLUMN memberCountry   FORMAT A8 HEADING 'Country';
COLUMN memberState     FORMAT A10 HEADING 'State';
COLUMN memberCity      FORMAT A17 HEADING 'City';
COLUMN memberAddress   FORMAT A20 HEADING 'Address';
COLUMN memberZipCode   FORMAT A7  HEADING 'ZipCode';

CREATE TABLE Member (
    memberID        VARCHAR2(6) NOT NULL,
    memberName      VARCHAR2(50) NOT NULL,
    contactNum      VARCHAR2(12) NOT NULL,
    memberEmail     VARCHAR2(40) NOT NULL,
    dob             DATE NOT NULL,
    registerDate    DATE NOT NULL,
    expiryDate      DATE NOT NULL,
    memberStatus    VARCHAR2(20) NOT NULL,
    memberCountry   VARCHAR2(30) NOT NULL,
    memberState     VARCHAR2(35) NOT NULL,
    memberCity      VARCHAR2(40) NOT NULL,
    memberAddress  VARCHAR2(40) NOT NULL,
    memberZipCode   VARCHAR2(6) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (memberID),
    CONSTRAINT chk_memberID_format CHECK (REGEXP_LIKE(memberID, '^M[0-9]{5}$'))
);
